caches.name: MainWindow icon texture cache
caches.maximumLifetime: plugin/window lifetime, with FIFO eviction above 256 entries
caches.invalidation: eviction on capacity; all local keys are released when the window is disposed; shared texture wrappers remain provider-owned

caches.name: MainController visible collection view
caches.maximumLifetime: until the next command rebuilds view state
caches.invalidation: every controller command rebuilds the view; refresh, filter, slot, plate, and item changes replace the prior view

caches.name: Game item icon catalog
caches.invalidation: Disposed with plugin;256 rows per update,100000 source row limit;one final sort;drawer uses clipped rows and the256-entry texture cache.

cachePolicy: Plugin-owned collections are numerically bounded. No time-based or unbounded cache is permitted in Draw or recurring update paths.
